# Read Primitives — Map Access

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Access map values by key

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH supplier_costs AS (
    SELECT
        ps_suppkey,
        MAP(
            ARRAY_AGG(CAST(ps_partkey AS VARCHAR)),
            ARRAY_AGG(ps_supplycost)
        ) as part_costs
    FROM partsupp
    WHERE ps_suppkey <= 10
    GROUP BY ps_suppkey
)
SELECT
    ps_suppkey,
    MAP_EXTRACT(part_costs, '1')[1] as cost_for_part_1,
    MAP_EXTRACT(part_costs, '5')[1] as cost_for_part_5
FROM supplier_costs
ORDER BY ps_suppkey
LIMIT 10;
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def map_access_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Access map values by key.

    Expression-family implementation using map element access.
    """
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    # Access map elements
    return (
        _partsupp_map_expression(ctx, 10)
        .select(
            "ps_suppkey",
            col("part_costs").map.get(lit("1")).alias("cost_for_part_1"),
            col("part_costs").map.get(lit("5")).alias("cost_for_part_5"),
        )
        .limit(10)
    )
```
